chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Yaqoub ibn Yazeed, raising it, said:
Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) said: 'The water of the Nile of Egypt deadens the hearts'.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of the Nile's water according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies the Nile's water as a spiritual catalyst that 'deadens the hearts,' a concept often linked to the specific environmental or metaphysical conditions of Egypt that hindered spiritual receptivity. Shia scholars interpret this not merely as a physical trait but as a symbolic reflection of the region's historical and spiritual state, where abundance sometimes led to hardness or neglect of divine remembrance.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, raising it, said,
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The water of the Nile of Egypt deadens the hearts’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Ya‘qub ibn Yazid in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “’Amir al-Mu’minin, has said, ‘Water of the Nile of Misr (Egypt) deadens the heart.’”
